$description: Toza v2 design tokens, Study G system (build/g P1b: light + dark, Frank Ruhl Libre + Assistant, 12-column grid, radius 0). W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. Single source of colours, type, spacing and radii (V-037). styles/tokens.css is generated from this file by scripts/build-tokens.mjs; never edit it by hand. Alpha colours are CSS colour strings (rgb() with slash alpha) so the generated CSS is exact.

com.toza.css.note: A token may carry a dark-theme value in $extensions[com.toza.css].dark (a literal or an {alias}); the generator emits those under :root[data-theme=dark]. CSS variable name = '--' + path joined with '-' (a leaf named DEFAULT drops its suffix). A group with 'prefix' replaces its own path with that prefix. A token with 'emit: false' is documentation only. Composite typography tokens emit one variable per member: --type-<name>-<member>.

sans.$description: UI and facts (D105): prices, tier item lists, labels, navigation, buttons, footer. Self-hosted Assistant (latin + hebrew subsets).

body.$description: Body copy: the serif (D104). Flowbite reads --font-body.

serif.$description: Headlines, situation lines, tier names, all paragraphs (D105). No italic exists; none is synthesised. Self-hosted Frank Ruhl Libre (latin + hebrew subsets).

paper-deep.$description: Cool grey (Aspen ground). Alternating sections, start card, bars.

ink.$description: Ink. Headings, primary action, inverse sections. In the dark theme it becomes the light text colour.

ink-soft.$description: Ink, one step lighter. Primary action hover.

text.$description: Body text. Also the semantic text colour.

mint.$description: Mint. Fill and small marks only (D84): never text, never a link colour.

sand.$description: Cool grey (Aspen box). Second recessed tone (tier boxes).

shadow-ambient.$description: Specimen document: soft ambient shadow (ink at 35%).

on-dark-border-strong.$description: Ghost button border on the inverse surface (white at 55%).

on-dark-text.$description: Body copy on the inverse surface (white at 88%).

on-dark-text-muted.$description: Captions on the inverse surface (white at 75%).

on-dark-rule.$description: Hairlines on the inverse surface (white at 20%).

action-inverse-hover.$description: Primary action on the inverse surface: hover background.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed surface for alternating bands and callouts.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text on surface. 6.9:1 on paper (light).

accent.$description: Accent for text marks and rules: ink (brass retired; mint is fill-only).

accent-on-dark.$description: Accent on inverse surfaces: white; in the dark theme the dark ground.

action-inverse.$description: Primary action on inverse surfaces: background.

on-action-inverse.$description: Primary action on inverse surfaces: text.

flowbite.$description: Flowbite semantic variables remapped onto the Toza palette. Names are fixed by Flowbite; do not rename. body is the primary text colour, body-subtle the secondary one; neutral-primary* is the page paper, neutral-secondary*/tertiary* the recessed paper, dark* the ink, default*/neutral-quaternary the hairline.

body.$description: Body copy (html/body): serif, 17 to 20 px fluid.

display.$description: h1 / .display. Size is set per page (home hero: 2.625rem, 3.75rem from sm, 5rem from lg).

h2.$description: Section heading (.h2). Fluid size: CSS clamp(), not expressible as a DTCG dimension.

label.$description: Small label (Study G label): Assistant 600, 12 px, tracked; set in uppercase by the element (text-transform is not a DTCG member).

numeral.$description: Prices (.numeral): Assistant (D105). Also font-feature-settings: "lnum", "tnum" (lining, tabular figures).

margin.$description: Outer page margin of the full-bleed grid (D86).

bar.$description: Phone message bar height (below md), excluding the iOS safe-area inset.

text.$description: Tailwind font-size scale entries (text-<name>) for the Direction A display sizes.

h2.$description: Section heading, fluid (text-h2); same value as type.h2 font size.

numeral.$description: Prices line height (leading-numeral). Tailwind's leading-none is overridden by Flowbite's theme, so prices name their own.

wrap.$description: Content width as a Tailwind container size (max-w-wrap).

hero.$description: Measure of the typographic hero headline (max-w-hero), about 18-22 characters per line at hero size (V-045).

spacing.$description: Named Tailwind spacing steps for the page layout (px-gutter, py-section, ...), aliases of the layout tokens.

color.$description: Focus outline on the page surface.

breakpoint.$description: Tailwind defaults, documented here because the CSS media queries use them. Not emitted: redefining --breakpoint-* would change every responsive utility.

md.$description: Stage columns, price strip brackets, price facts as ruled rows.

lg.$description: Full desktop layout, section padding 4.5rem, sticky navs.
